comparison.objective: Diagnose and repair a keyed fixture by replacing its faulty guide and verifying both orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential testing, lock-pin removal, guide extraction/insertion, part selection, and repeated seating checks.
comparison.success_condition: Fault demonstrated, original quarantined, correct spare pinned, forward seating and backward blocking verified, then part returned and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests maintenance diagnosis, component replacement, and keyed insertion checks rather than impact finishing or debris containment.
